text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide rebuilt her "formula for 
victory" from the ground up in preparation 
for the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the process of building her theories, 
her physique had gained an imposing edge. 
Both Narita Taishin and Winning Ticket 
acknowledged how much she had changed from 
before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Big Three "BNW" spark fierce rivalry 
as the final Classic race now begins—!
